title: Signing
description: Artifact-signing infrastructure: one backend (keyless, local key, or KMS) and an explicit transparency-log stance. The backend determines which extra fields are required.

verification_key.description: Public-key reference used on verify when backend=key or backend=kms. cosign rejects private keys at verification, so a verify-only environment declares this instead of receiving the signing key; with kms it is the Transit key's exported public key, so verification never round-trips through the KMS and the KMS token stays confined to the signing phase. Absent, 'key' (or the KMS) serves both operations.
